paper_metadata.title: Microstructural stability and mechanical properties of BCC-based Fe3.5Cr1.5NiAl0.8 multicomponent alloy
paper_metadata.journal: Transactions of Nonferrous Metals Society of China

evidence.quote: The effect of temperature on the microstructural stability and mechanical properties of ordered ellipsoidal B2-NiAl nanoprecipitates in a novel body-centered-cubic (BCC)-based Fe3.5Cr1.5NiAl0.8 multicomponent alloy (MCA) was investigated.

provide a high yield strength (809.2−1164.1 MPa) owing to the low-misfit coherent precipitation strengthening mechanism
